name: antigem-plugins
description: Official Antigem plugins repository: 2D Video Editing Studio and Facebook Automation & SEO Studio.

plugins.name: 2d-video-editing-studio

plugins.name: facebook-automation
plugins.description: Senior Social Media Manager & Production-grade Facebook automation engine for AntiGem Mobile Browser (m.facebook.com & www.facebook.com), Kiwi Browser, Termux, and Desktop: precision visualViewport touch coordinates, 4-tier media attachment with DOM preview verification, 1-touch unified Photo + Deep Quote + Viral Hook + Hashtags publishing, scheduling, anti-duplicate protection, and post re-edit/delete.
